entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Customer Service'.
Customer Service.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Jordan. How can I help you today?

Yeah, hi. I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. I've had it for a couple of weeks and it's just not working out for me. I need to know what the return window is because I'm not sure when I can get it in the mail.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number, please?
It's Sarah Gable. Order number VF-8675309. Look, I'm just really busy this month, so I need to know how much time I have.

Okay, Sarah, I'm pulling up your order now. I see the VeloBand Pulse, delivered about 15 days ago. Let's see... okay, **don't worry**, our **standard policy** for the Pulse gives you a full **90 days** to return it. You have **plenty of time**.
Oh! 90 days? Seriously? Wow, I thought it was much shorter. That's a huge relief. Great.

Yes, absolutely. We want to make sure you're... hold on one moment, Sarah. I need to correct myself. I am so sorry, I was looking at the policy for our apparel line. I sincerely apologize for that mix-up.
Wait, what? What are you talking about? You just said 90 days. What is the actual policy?
I am truly sorry for the misinformation. The correct return window for all VeloFit electronics, including the VeloBand Pulse, is 30 days from the delivery date.

Are you kidding me?! Thirty days? You just told me I had plenty of time and not to worry, and now you're saying I have less than half of that left? That's unacceptable! I made plans based on what you just told me.

I completely understand your frustration, and I take full responsibility for my error. That was my mistake, and I am going to fix it. While I cannot change the company-wide 30-day policy, I am noting on your account that you were misinformed by me personally. Because of that, I am making a one-time exception and extending your return window to 60 days.
So... I have 60 days from my delivery date now? For sure?

That is correct. I've just processed the exception and sent you a pre-paid return shipping label to your email on file. You'll have until that new 60-day mark to send it back for a full refund. Again, I deeply apologize for the confusion I caused.
Okay... wow. I mean, I was about to get really angry. But, that actually solves my problem completely. Thank you. I appreciate you fixing your mistake like that.
Of course, Sarah. It was the right thing to do. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Jordan.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
